Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G3004; to surname, select:--call, choose.
BiblicalUsage: Epilegomai means to surname, to choose, to call by an added name. There is at Jerusalem a pool called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda; and Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
TheologicalSignificance: Names given and choices made both mark a person, I believe: the pool is known by its name, and Paul by the companion he chose.
